ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Enemy: Black Manta has sworn revenge on Aqualad and the Xebelians certainly have plans for him. Motivation—Responsibility: Aqualad didn’t ask for his powers, but he’s accepted his fate. The Key: Aqualad is a living key, capable of opening or closing the Bermuda Triangle’s portal to the extradimensional Xebel.
